{{Short description|Romanian mathematician (1931–2016)}}
{{more citations needed|date=February 2015}}
'''Petru T. Mocanu''' (1 June 1931 – 28 March 2016) was a [[Romania]]n [[mathematician]] who was elected in 2009 as a titular member of the [[Romanian Academy]].

Mocanu was born in [[Brăila]].<ref>{{in lang|ro}} [http://www.acad.ro/bdar/armembriLit.php?vidT=M Membrii Academiei Române din 1866 până în prezent], at the Romanian Academy site</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cs.ubbcluj.ro/trecerea-in-nefiinta-a-acad-prof-univ-dr-petru-mocanu/|title=Trecerea în eternitate a acad. prof. univ. dr. Petru Mocanu - Facultatea de Matematică şi Informatică|publisher=ubbcluj.ro|language=ro}}</ref> He studied at the Nicolae Bălcescu High School in Brăila, graduating in 1950.<ref name="matrom">{{cite web|url=https://www.romai.ro/documente_poze/Publicatii/MAtRom/MatRom_2.pdf|title=Medalioanele matematicienilor români contemporani|publisher=www.romai.ro|language=ro|access-date=2018-03-05|archive-date=2017-08-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170809070841/https://www.romai.ro/documente_poze/Publicatii/MAtRom/MatRom_2.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> He then went to study mathematics at [[Babeș-Bolyai University]] in [[Cluj-Napoca]], completing his [[B.Sc]] in 1953, and his [[Ph.D.]] in 1959.  His dissertation, written under the supervision of [[Gheorghe Călugăreanu]], was titled ''Variational methods in the theory of univalent functions''. He continued as faculty at Babeș-Bolyai University, rising to the rank of Professor in 1970.

Mocanu was an invited professor at the [[Gamal Abdel Nasser University of Conakry|University of Conakry]] in 1966–1967, and the [[Ohio State University]] in 1992.<ref name="matrom"/>
